main_topics: Role of AI in future real estate transactions

episode_summary: This episode emphasizes the importance of daily client communication to prevent losing deals and discusses the role of AI in the future of real estate. Ben Lalez shares insights on how agents can improve productivity by focusing on execution rather than building complex systems. The conversation also explores the balance between leveraging AI and maintaining the human touch in real estate transactions.
